en.t: Forget it, just look how cold and desolate this vigil is...

units.source_text: 再说，阿清的鬼魂怎么不在竹林子里游荡呢？

en.t: Besides, why should A-Qing's ghost not be wandering in the bamboo grove?

units.source_text: 那边那位，你听着，不许进我们的澡塘来。

en.t: You over there, listen: you are not allowed to come into our bathhouse.

units.source_text: 我们的温泉可不是洗脏身子的地方！”

en.t: Our hot spring is certainly not a place for washing filthy bodies!"
